changes.description: Coordinates in degrees may be written as degrees, minutes and seconds, such as 05° 56' 00" S, as well as decimal numbers, in a CSV imported here and in points from a connected table (the practitioner, 2026-11-18, of a USGS table of Africa's mineral facilities: "the more urgent thing is the degrees decimal conversion assuming the format is correct"). They are converted to decimal degrees for the point; the column keeps its text. A value with no hemisphere is read as north or east and counted in the step's sentence. A value that cannot be read leaves its record without a position, with the reason, where a CSV in degrees used to be refused whole. Checked on the USGS table: 582 of 652 rows agree exactly with its own decimal columns and 13 within rounding; 57 disagree, mostly errors in those columns.
